questions.question: In key exchange protocols, what fundamental security property does Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) provide?
options: It ensures that compromising a server's long-term private key does not expose session keys established in past communications.
It guarantees that symmetric session keys can be safely reused across multiple sessions without losing security assurances.
It automatically revokes compromised public key certificates in real time across distributed PKI nodes.
It prevents quantum computers from executing Shor's algorithm on asymmetric key pairs.

questions.question: Shor's algorithm threatens modern asymmetric cryptosystems because it can solve which mathematical problems in polynomial time on a quantum computer?
options: Finding SHA-256 hash collisions and preimage attacks
Integer factorization and the discrete logarithm problem
Shortest vector problems in lattice-based cryptography
Symmetric block cipher key expansion and substitution box inversion

questions.question: Which mechanism allows a Return-Oriented Programming (ROP) attack to successfully execute arbitrary malicious logic while bypassing Data Execution Prevention (DEP / NX bit)?
options: Dynamically compiling shellcode into memory marked as read-write-execute at runtime
Injecting instructions directly into the non-executable stack and executing them via a stack pivot
Chaining together short sequence snippets of existing executable code ('gadgets') ending in return instructions
Overwriting kernel page tables to remove memory protection flags globally across user space

questions.question: Web browsers enforce the Same-Origin Policy (SOP) to isolate document contexts. Which exact combination of elements defines an 'origin'?
options: IP address, subnet mask, and URL path
Domain name, HTTP headers, and user session ID
TLS certificate thumbprint, protocol, and query parameters
Protocol (scheme), hostname (domain), and port number

questions.question: A software application checks a user's permission to access a file and subsequently opens that file in a separate system call. If an unprivileged user replaces the target file with a symbolic link to a protected system file between these two operations, what vulnerability is being exploited?
options: Integer Overflow
Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition
Format String Injection
Use-After-Free (UAF)
